SOFA¶

The SOFA layer is the structured file interface for SOFA data. It loads SOFA files into SOFA objects backed by netCDF4.Dataset and exposes dimensions, global attributes, variable attributes, and variables through wrapper collections.

Use this layer when you need direct access to the SOFA file structure.
